column1: # Entries every build must contain: zip name without .zip, term, reading (tab-separated).
# scripts/validate.ts fails the build when one is missing, so a parser change that drops or mangles
# them is caught before a release. Covers plain words, several readings of one character, the
# simplified headword rows, the neutral tone, erhua, a missing apostrophe in the sheet (南歐) and
# characters outside the BMP. 八輩兒五沒根基 is filed under its 變 (variant) reading, which depends on
# the 變體類型 column of the sheet.
# A fourth column names a headword: the row must then be one of the rows of that headword's entry
# (same reading, same sequence number) and show the term after that headword: 裡面、裏面. That is
# how the lookup-only spellings of spellings.ts are checked: 修訂本 has 爲 as an entry of its own,
# so its mere presence would prove nothing.
# A line with only a zip name and !term says the zip must have no row for that term. 著名 is read
# zhù, so it must not be filed under 着名; nor 編著 under the simplified 编着, which is what OpenCC
